description: Mom reflects on how Bjarne gradually stopped calling as his career accelerated.

openingMessages.speaker: Mom
openingMessages.text: I just wanted to check in before the week gets away from us again. I know you're busy, honey, but I miss talking to you.

choices.text: I've missed talking to you too.
I'm sorry I've been so distant.
You don't need to worry about me.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Well, then perhaps we should do something about that! We don't need a special occasion to talk.

choices.text: Did I used to call you more often?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Oh, sweetheart. You don't need to apologize. I just want you to remember that you have people who care about you.

choices.text: Did I used to call you more often?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: I know you can look after yourself, Bjarne. But that doesn't mean you always have to.

choices.text: Did I used to call you more often?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Oh, absolutely. When you first started working, you'd call me almost every other day.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Then you got promoted, and things got busier. I suppose I got used to hearing from you less and less.

choices.text: I'm sorry. I should have made more time.
I don't want that to happen anymore.
I guess I didn't notice how much time had passed.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Don't be. Just don't wait until there's a birthday or a holiday to call your mother, alright?

lines.speaker: Pragmatist
lines.text: A recurring calendar reminder may be the most valuable feature we've ever implemented.
